queries_run: LLY Eli Lilly antitrust OR FTC OR DOJ OR EU competition investigation 2026
Eli Lilly regulatory scrutiny drug pricing regulation 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 指出 FTC 與歐洲等競爭主管機關對產業併購的持續關注，可能延遲或增加 Lilly 商務發展（併購/授權）活動的成本與風險。
findings.excerpt: Continued regulatory focus on business combinations in our industry, including by the Federal Trade Commission and competition authorities in Europe and other jurisdictions, and heightened competition for attractive targets has and could continue to delay, jeopardize, or increase the costs or risks of our business development activities.

findings.claim: 2025年12月歐盟就藥品通則立法達成原則性協議，將以條件制縮短部分智財保護（資料保護期上限）。
findings.excerpt: an agreement-in-principle announced in December 2025 between the European Commission, Council and Parliament to revise the EU's general pharmaceutical legislation would make conditional the length of certain pharmaceutical intellectual property incentives, including by reductions in maximum data protection periods.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋未見 FTC/DOJ/歐盟對 Lilly 的反壟斷調查；2026 年有州政府與民間反壟斷訴訟（佛州 insulin/GLP-1 回扣、Strive 複方藥局案，搜尋摘要為二手轉述，未取得逐字原文）。IRA 定價、MFN 為價格監管面。

clues.claim: 佛州檢察長 2026-09 於 Miami-Dade 對 Lilly、Novo、Sanofi 及 PBM 提起 insulin/GLP-1 回扣反壟斷與不實交易訴訟。
clues.source: Bloomberg Government: Florida Sues Lilly, Sanofi, CVS in Insulin Antitrust Action

clues.claim: 複方藥局 Strive 對 Lilly、Novo 提 GLP-1 反壟斷訴訟，德州聯邦法官認定未能主張可信的市場。
clues.source: Bloomberg Law: Eli Lilly, Novo Hit With Antitrust Suit From Drug Compounder
